description: In February 2006, two then-armymen allegedly killed a woman and her twin 17-day-old infants in Kollam, Kerala. Close to 19 years later, the Central Bureau of Investigation finally tracked them. | News
body_lead: In February 2006, two then-armymen allegedly killed a woman identified as Ranjini and her twin 17-day-old girls in Anchal, Kollam, in Kerala. The suspects, Divil Kumar and Rajesh had a simple alibi-- They were at the Pathankot military station on duty. At a time when surveillance cameras or call records gave limited leads to the police, the case led nowhere and turned cold. That was till 2025 -- nearly two decades later -- when the Central Bureau of Investigation tracked them in Pondicherry.
